comparisons.peer_summary: The company offers infrastructure and security software to simplify IT environments, support hybrid cloud platforms, and manage mission-critical workloads for Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, including fibre channel storage networking products.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Avago describe developing and offering software stacks or solutions to enable their hardware products and specific customer needs. AMD explicitly mentions developing 'software stacks that are used to enable our high-performance products' and working with customers to define 'customized solutions' to match requirements. Similarly, Avago offers 'infrastructure software solutions' designed to help enterprises simplify IT environments and manage mission-critical workloads across various platforms. While AMD focuses on enabling its specific high-performance CPUs/GPUs through developer tools and drivers, Avago focuses on simplifying complex enterprise IT and hybrid cloud environments through its infrastructure software portfolio.

sentences.text: We develop world-class software stacks that are used to enable our high-performance products.
We work closely with our customers to define and develop customized solutions to precisely match their requirements.

Our infrastructure software solutions help enterprises simplify their information technology ("IT") environments so they can increase business velocity and flexibility, and enable customers to plan, develop, deliver, automate, manage, and secure applications across mainframe, distributed, edge, mobile, and private and hybrid cloud platforms.

Our portfolio of industry-leading infrastructure and security software is designed to modernize, optimize, and secure the most complex private and hybrid cloud environments, enabling scalability, agility, automation, insights, resiliency and security, making it easy for customers to run their mission-critical workloads.

comparisons.peer_summary: Compute offerings include supercomputing platforms and servers with GPUs, DPUs, interconnects, and AI/HPC software stacks, alongside NVIDIA AI Enterprise software, DGX Cloud service, acceleration libraries, APIs, SDKs, and application frameworks.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA highlight the integration of software stacks with their hardware offerings to support AI and high-performance computing. AMD states it develops 'software stacks' including tools, compilers, and drivers for its CPUs and GPUs to enable high-performance products. NVIDIA similarly describes its compute offerings as bringing together GPUs and 'fully optimized AI and high-performance computing, or HPC, software stacks,' alongside specific enterprise software. Both companies emphasize that their software is integral to delivering high-performance outcomes, though NVIDIA provides more granular detail on specific enterprise software products (NVIDIA AI Enterprise, DGX Cloud) compared to AMD's general description of development tools and drivers.

sentences.text: We develop world-class software stacks that are used to enable our high-performance products.
Our software stacks include development tools, compilers, and drivers for our CPUs, APUs, GPUs and FPGAs.

Our compute offerings include supercomputing platforms and servers, bringing together our energy efficient GPUs, DPUs, interconnects, and fully optimized AI and high-performance computing, or HPC, software stacks.
In addition, they include NVIDIA AI Enterprise software; our DGX Cloud service; and a growing body of acceleration libraries, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks.

comparisons.peer_topic: Processor architecture and AI Engine capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm utilizes System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing, including Oryon and Kryo CPUs and Adreno GPUs, to enable high-performance, low-power computing. The Qualcomm AI Engine features dedicated hardware and the Hexagon NPU for high-performance on-device AI inference, supported by the AI Stack and AI Hub to simplify developer integration.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Qualcomm describe providing software components or stacks to support their hardware processors and enable specific computing capabilities. AMD develops 'software stacks' including development tools, compilers, and drivers for its CPUs and GPUs to enable high-performance products. Qualcomm describes the 'Qualcomm AI Stack,' a unified AI software portfolio designed to help developers optimize and deploy AI models using their chipset solutions. Both companies tie their software offerings directly to the performance and functionality of their processor hardware, with AMD focusing on general high-performance computing drivers/tools and Qualcomm focusing specifically on AI model deployment for mobile/IoT.
